spec.abstain_behavior: Return an abstain phase when there is no concrete lookup constraint, multiple matching contacts, no stable person_id, a self-contact target, or missing update fields for modify_contact.
spec.description: Contact CRUD planner/bridge. Use for add_contact, remove_contact, or modify_contact tasks where the user gives a concrete contact id, phone number, name, or relationship. Before search, it returns search_contacts kwargs. After search_contacts returns visible contacts, call it again with the contacts list to get final original ToolSandbox action kwargs. It never performs side effects.
spec.final_state_preservation_plan: The tool does not perform side effects, so no final state preservation is necessary.
spec.generalization_rationale: Contact CRUD pilots showed current tools were hidden or only helped message-recency contact update. This bridge covers scalar/id contact CRUD without encoding scenario ids or expected answers.
spec.grading_accounting_note: The tool provides a clear mapping from scalar constraints to search parameters, improving the reliability of contact searches.

planner_failures: prior designs were too broad or unstable; split to scalar search query only
